chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Born on a farm: twin brother and his name
summary: He was the youngest of 14 children and a twin; his twin C. B. died at six months, and he changed Charlie to Jay C.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Right, O.K. Can we just go back just for a minute to the earliest times, like when you grew up with your folks as a kid. Could you give us the things that you can remember the earliest when you were a kid? Your earliest impressions? Like can you tell us something about your mother and father?
About playing?
No, just as a child.
No, I was born on a farm.
Could you tell us something about that?
I can tell you all about it. I love it!
Would you tell us about down on the farm?
Down on the farm... ch, that's pretty! and I loved it, no kidding.
Would you tell us something about it?
Well, it I was 14 in the family.
14 brothers and sisters.
Yeah. I was a twin.
You a twin?
His twin died when he was 6 months. That made 13 in the family.
Do you remember what his name was?
Well, mine was Jay C. and his was C. B.
What did C. B. stand for?
I wasn't tell you - yes, I will. It was Charlie (Bronica.) Mine was just Charlie but I changed it to Jay C.
Jessie Charlie?
No, Jay C., J-a-y C. and spelled like that ever since.
